1. Address critical hardware complaints regarding the camera and screen quality — negative keywords highlight these as primary pain points driving the 26.8% dissatisfaction rate.
2. Investigate battery performance consistency across both Android and iPhone models — battery is a major talking point in positive reviews that requires standardization to protect overall sentiment.
3. Review third-party fulfillment and product listing accuracy on Amazon — recurring brand mentions suggest delivery or packaging issues may be unnecessarily skewing customer perception.
